cohort: The study included 14,583 women who underwent frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles that resulted in a live singleton newborn from January 2015 to June 2022.
finding: Singleton live births in the vanishing twin syndrome (VTS) group are at an increased risk of preterm birth and low birth weight compared with those in the non-VTS singleton group in FET cycles.
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were observed in terms of cesarean delivery rate between the VTS and non-VTS groups.
